cohort: Nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies who attempted vaginal delivery
finding: The increased risk of cesarean delivery after labor induction among nulliparous women is mainly attributable to lower cervical dilatation at hospital admission and higher rates of labor complications.
mod_finding: Induced women were more likely to deliver by cesarean (35.9%) than women in spontaneous labor (18.9%), unadjusted OR 2.35 (95% CI 1.97-2.79).
